description: cua-lite preprocessed version of GUIOdyssey (hflqf88888/GUIOdyssey). A long-horizon cross-app Android mobile dataset of 8,334 task trajectories over ~128k screenshots. Produces two cohorts: use (multi-step agent episodes) and understanding (per-step screen captioning from the source `description` annotations).
extra_notes: Source `info` coordinates are already normalized to [0, 1000] (per the upstream README) and are used directly — they are NOT device pixels.
